en.answer: Even if the effect of <<9153>> is applying, you can still activate the effect of <<15015>>. However, since the effect of <<9153>> prevents you from Special Summoning, you cannot target an "Unchained" monster with the effect of <<15015>>, and must target an "Unchained" Spell/Trap Card.
en.question: If the effect of <<9153>> is applying, can I activate the effect of <<15015>> that Sets an "Unchained" card from my Graveyard?
en.title: If the effect of <<9153>> is applying, can I activate the effect of <<15015>> that Sets an "Unchained" card from my Graveyard?

ja.answer:
質問の状況の場合でも、「<<15015>>」の『①』のモンスター効果を発動する事はできます。

ただし、「<<9153>>」の『①』の効果によってモンスターの特殊召喚を行う事ができませんので、「破械」と名のついたモンスターを対象に選択する事はできず、「破械」と名のついた魔法・罠カードを対象に選択する事になります。
